items.markdown:
Products at 7-Eleven in Thailand are very cheap, with `most basic items, snacks, and drinks costing between 5 THB and 50 THB ($0.15 to $1.45 USD)` . Popular budget items include bottled water (7 THB), toasties (32 THB), and local energy drinks (10 THB).[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVODIsLDhXa/) [[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVODIsLDhXa/)[[2]](https://www.cktravels.com/thailand-7-11-eleven-what-you-can-buy/)[[3]](https://www.tiktok.com/@sabrinaescapes/video/7325823256706010401)[[4]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/ShowTopic-g293915-i3686-k2434298-Water-Thailand.html)

Drinks and Beverages

- **Bottled Water (600ml):** 7 THB
- **Energy Drinks (Red Bull / M-150):** 10 THB
- **Fresh Thai Milk Tea / Iced Coffee:** 20 to 30 THB
- **Soft Drinks (Cans like Pepsi/Coke):** 16 to 18 THB[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVODIsLDhXa/) 

Food and Ready Meals

- **Ham and Cheese Toastie:** 32 THB
- **Instant Noodles (Cup/Bowl):** 14 to 25 THB
- **Ready-to-eat Microwave Rice Dishes:** 40 to 55 THB
- **Sausages and Dim Sum (per pack):** 20 to 35 THB[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVODIsLDhXa/) 

Snacks and Desserts

- **Chips and Crisps (Small bags):** 10 to 20 THB
- **Chocolate Bars / Biscuits:** 10 to 30 THB
- **Ice Cream Bars / Matcha Cones:** 15 to 35 THB[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVODIsLDhXa/) 

Alcohol (Legal sale hours 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–00:00)

- **Local Beer (330ml can like Singha/Leo):** 41 THB
- **Local Beer (500ml can):** 50 to 55 THB
- **Large Beer Bottles (620ml):** 60 to 65 THB[[1]](https://www.cktravels.com/7-eleven-thailand-beer/)

Personal Care and Travel Items

- **Travel-size toiletries (Shampoo/Lotion):** 20 to 45 THB
- **Cooling Powder (Snake Brand small):** 30 to 45 THB
- **Face Masks (Sheet masks):** 29 to 49 THB
